vulnerability.name: USN-5420-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that Vorbis incorrectly handled certain files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2017-14160, CVE-2018-10392, CVE-2018-10393)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in Vorbis. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
